scenes.heading: LIMIT REACHED? -98%
scenes.say: Your Claude Code hit its limit again — what if the real number went down 90%?
Headroom compresses everything your agent reads — tool output, logs, files — before the model sees it. Ninety-eight percent saved on one real task. It is reversible.
Ponytail stops your agent writing ten lines where two work. Its own benchmark says fifty-four percent less code — and output tokens are the expensive ones.
When the limit still comes, OmniRoute switches you to free models mid-session. Graphify maps your codebase once — the agent stops re-reading it.

idea: Claude Code users hit usage limits mid-task; four open-source plugins cut token burn from four sides (compress context, write less code, reroute to free providers, map the repo once) — the reference demo shows 17,832 tokens down to 312.

claims.text: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the model — 60–95% fewer tokens on JSON, about 15–20% on coding-agent turns, reversible and local-first.
Ponytail makes Claude Code write far less code — its own benchmarks claim roughly 54% less code and about 20% cheaper API cost.

OmniRoute reroutes agent traffic to free model providers the moment your usage limit hits, claiming roughly 1.47 billion free tokens a month across 352 providers; Graphify maps the codebase once locally so agents stop re-reading the same files.
